payload.author: claude
payload.body: Docs follow-up found during the binary/init fix: docs/operations.md still contains TS @fricken/server code examples (createFrickServer, createS3BlobBytesDriver, the Resend email adapter, @fricken/server/push/apns-adapter subpaths) that describe the deleted TS server API. The doc agent added a top-of-file caveat but the snippets should be translated to the Rust option surface (or removed) as the corresponding features (S3 blob driver, outbound email, OTel) are ported. The obsolete docker/ TS recipes were already removed + docs/docker-recipes rewritten around ops/deploy/server.Dockerfile.
